The feet appear visually correct in the raw image, but the pose uncertainty suggests the underlying geometry may be slightly 'soft' or ill-defined compared to a rigid biological structure. I am downgrading the artifact score slightly to account for this structural uncertainty in the legs, despite the clean visual appearance.
